home.title: Introduction
home.tagline: Primus UI is a copy-paste component library, not an npm package. Each component is a self-contained folder you drop into your project. No runtime dependency, no version lock, no abstraction layer between you and the markup.
home.howToUseP1: Components live in components-library/. Each folder is independent: drop it into your project and it works on its own, with no other files needed from this repo.
home.howToUseP2: Pick the version that fits your stack. You can mix versions per component without any issues.
home.flavorTailwindDesc: A single .tsx file with Tailwind utility classes. Zero CSS files, zero @apply. Edit className strings directly.
home.flavorScssDesc: A .tsx that uses pu-* classes with overridable CSS variables. No Tailwind required.
home.flavorDrupalDesc: A Single Directory Component with Twig template, .component.yml schema, and the same SCSS tokens.
home.step1: Open the component page you want and pick a version (Tailwind, SCSS, or Drupal).
home.step2: Copy the components-library/[ComponentName]/ folder into your project.
home.step3: Import and use. For the SCSS version, import the .scss file once in your app entry.
home.step4: To customize tokens, override CSS variables in your own CSS — no source edits needed.
home.emptyHint: Add the first one to components-library/
home.drupalThemeNote: In Drupal snippets, replace THEME-NAME with your theme or module machine name (e.g. my_theme:button).

componentsPage.title: Components
componentsPage.description: Browse the documented Primus UI primitives. Each page explains usage paths, props, SCSS variables, and implementation notes.

docsPage.title: Build with Primus UI
docsPage.description: Primus UI is documented as a source-first component system for Next.js, Next.js Tailwind, and Drupal SDC. Pick the output that matches your project, copy the folder, then own the code.
docsPage.installationBody: There is no runtime package to install for the library workflow. Each component is a self-contained folder under components-library/.
docsPage.usageScss: Copy the TSX and SCSS pair, then import the SCSS once where the component is used.
docsPage.usageTailwind: Copy the Tailwind TSX version when the consuming product already owns Tailwind.
docsPage.usageDrupal: Copy the Drupal directory for Twig, component schema, and SCSS token overrides.
docsPage.tokensBody: SCSS outputs expose CSS variables so consuming apps can theme without editing component internals.
docsPage.outputNext: Source components with explicit styling and local ownership.
docsPage.outputDrupal: Single Directory Components for Drupal theme integration.

componentDescriptions.divider: A horizontal or vertical line for separating content sections.
componentDescriptions.grid-template: A responsive CSS grid wrapper with configurable column counts per breakpoint.
componentDescriptions.text: A polymorphic text element that renders a configurable HTML tag with overridable typography tokens.
componentDescriptions.heading: A polymorphic heading element (h1-h6) with weight variants and optional HTML rendering.
componentDescriptions.section-container: A section wrapper with configurable max-width and horizontal padding. Safe to nest because inner margin collapses automatically.
componentDescriptions.card: Content card with style variants, layout directions, image, and action buttons.
